notes.title: Recall: Empty Wishes Launches on Steam!
notes.notes:
[h2]Take advantage of a 10% launch discount on Steam for a limited time![/h2]

Set in Taiwan during the 2010s, [i][b]Recall: Empty Wishes[/b][/i] is a story-driven interactive adventure that follows Yonny, a young woman searching for answers behind the mysterious disappearance of her brother, Tommy. As she delves deeper into the past, she encounters an eerie world where forgotten wishes take shape, leading her to relive fragmented memories from multiple perspectives of key characters connected to Tommy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41236310/5f1e83ce3acd9fd28dc5cc5cf6a61afe852b4b20.jpg[/img]

[b]Story[/b]
When Yonny’s beloved brother, Tommy, vanishes without a trace, her determination to uncover the truth leads her to a surreal realm connected through an old toy phone receiver they used to play with as kids. This mysterious device allows Yonny and her friend, Phoebe, to delve into the memory echoes of key individuals tied to Tommy’s fate, revealing their deepest desires and secrets.

Through interactive 2D side-scrolling gameplay, players will relive pivotal moments in the lives of key characters, unravel a tangled web of mystery and emotion, and uncover choices that shape the story’s haunting conclusion. With a unique blend of fantasy, mystery, and horror, Recall: Empty Wishes invites players into an emotional detailed narrative that explores the fragile boundaries of memory, truth, and longing.

[b]Features:[/b]
- Unravel a gripping psychological mystery set in Taiwan during the 2010s with a connective cast of characters and multiple endings.
- Experience the story through multiple perspectives, immersing yourself in different characters' memories.
- Explore a hauntingly beautiful world crafted with pixel-art backgrounds and hand-drawn portraits.
Solve environmental puzzles and interact with forgotten wishes to reveal hidden truths.

#RecallEmptyWishes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41236310/1058f2421238e81a96e00df92cb718a5f484d20c.gif[/img]

notes.title: Last Chance to Play the Demo for Recall: Empty Wishes
notes.notes:
Attention echo seekers!

As we inch closer to the full release of [b]Recall: Empty Wishes[/b] on February 13, 2025, we wanted to give you an important update. The Steam demo for the game will no longer be available to play after January 27, 2025. If you haven’t yet experienced Yonny’s journey and glimpsed the Taiwanese psychological thriller that awaits, this is your final chance to do so before the full story unfolds.

We’re beyond excited for you to uncover the secrets in the complete game next month. In the meantime, make sure to wishlist Recall: Empty Wishes on Steam to stay up to date and show your support for this labor of love. Wishlisting not only helps you stay notified about launch day but also helps more players discover the game.

Thank you to everyone who’s played the demo, shared your thoughts, and supported this project so far. It’s been amazing to see your enthusiasm. We can’t wait to share the full experience with you soon!

- Puff Hook Studio

notes.title: Recall: Empty Wishes Launches February 13, 2025!
notes.notes:
Enter the echoes! [i]Recall: Empty Wishes[/i] arrives on Steam [b]February 13, 2025[/b] for [b]$14.99[/b]! Explore its haunting mysteries during launch week and enjoy a [b]10% launch discount[/b]! Don't miss this chance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41236310/050916c08342b44dba621f1f6659d711dfc1f5c8.png[/img]

[i]Recall: Empty Wishes[/i] is a gripping psychological thriller set in Taiwan during the 2010s, where reality and illusion collide. When Yonny’s beloved brother, Tommy, vanishes without a trace, her determination to uncover the truth leads her to a surreal realm connected through an old toy phone receiver. This mysterious device allows Yonny and her friend, Phoebe, to delve into the memory echoes of individuals tied to Tommy’s fate, revealing their deepest desires and secrets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41236310/573df627b471a6d98c587b5bf3acdc4544844b43.png[/img]

Through interactive 2D side-scrolling gameplay, players will relive pivotal moments in the lives of various characters, unravel a tangled web of mystery and emotion, and uncover choices that shape the story’s haunting conclusion. With a unique blend of fantasy, mystery, and horror, Recall: Empty Wishes invites players into an emotional detailed narrative that explores the fragile boundaries of memory, truth, and longing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41236310/3d75d476df8ce1d4837b4a8ad8bea5cf30ca5b55.png[/img]

Inspired by story-driven games such as [i]To the Moon[/i], [i]The Coma[/i], and [i]Detention[/i], [i]Recall: Empty Wishes[/i] is Taiwanese developer [b]Puff Hook Studio[/b]’s first game project, and has received the following awards: 
[list]
[*] Vision Get Wild PC Game 2021 - Bronze Award
[*] Bahamut ACG Award 2021 - TAICCA Special Award
[/list]
Uncover the chilling events surrounding the disappearance of Yonny’s missing brother, Tommy, in this psychological thriller set in 2010s Taiwan on February 13, 2025! 

Wishlist now to stay connected ahead of release!
